config.sample_end_rule: fixed common fitting window 2009-2024; identical to run 1
config.rho_selection: sigma=0.5, rho=1/sigma=2; model-compatible capital-labor complementarity analogy, not a direct V6 skill-input estimate; see ../../references/rho_selection.md
config.money_unit: trillion 2017 USD, all nominal values divided by calendar-year mean GDPDEF/100
config.labor_unit: million persons; fixed sample-mean levels in every executed scenario
config.regime: all sample dates treated as u as a maintained hypothesis, not an observed regime classification
config.scope: US annual conditional production block with constant exogenous labor endowments; no RoW, finance, regime-b or GE calibration
config.labor_mean_rule: unweighted arithmetic mean of each of H and L over the same 16 annual fitting rows, before wage bridging

sample.averaging_rule: unweighted arithmetic mean of each of H and L over the same 16 annual fitting rows, before wage bridging

status.scope: US annual conditional production block with constant exogenous labor endowments; no RoW, finance, regime-b or GE calibration
